ShortDescription.Value: Cities: Skylines 2 Multiplayer mod, build one shared city with a friend

Publish.LongDescription:
Play Cities: Skylines II together.
Cities: Skylines 2 Multiplayer is a client-server multiplayer mod that allows multiple players to build and manage the same city in real time. To host a game, start a multiplayer world, optionally protect it with a password, and share your IP address with your friends or share ur steamcode. If you encounter any issues or have feedback, our Discord server ( https://discord.gg/KFZTW2YSJt ) is the preferred place to get support and report bugs. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Colossal Order, Paradox Interactive, or Iceflake Studio.
Publish.ChangeLog: Version 1.7.1 Added the full server options to the normal Host Game flow, including player approval, simulation sync, Steam-friend auto-approval, and client resync policy controls. Added host approval prompts for client resync requests. Added batched synchronization for dense tree and prop brush placement and deletion. Added synchronization support for durable state used by compatible third-party mods and improved residential household income correction. Improved Steam Relay transfer-rate recovery under stale congestion reports. Milestone popups now close automatically after 10 seconds in multiplayer so an AFK player cannot hold the session paused. The Options page now shows the mod version on its General tab, and the read-only status rows there were removed.
